question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get?
ground_truth: Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid vacation per calendar year.
contexts: All full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid vacation per calendar year. Vacation days must be requested at least two weeks in advance and approved by the immediate supervisor.

question: What is the password policy?
ground_truth: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and include a mix of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters. They must be changed every 90 days.
